text.text_excerpt: Finally got a chance to catch up with the Food Drunk Food Truck yesterday. After hearing so much about the King Cake burger through their FB page I figured I'd give it a try. It was exactly as advertised, not really sure if I liked it though. It was a little too messy to eat, and not sure if I liked the frosting on top. The Fat Duck Fries on the other hand were unbelievable! Perfectly cooked, crunchy and not over cooked. Add in the spicy ketchup and it took it to a whole new level. I'll definitely be going back soon!

It just so happens that Food Drunk Food Truck parks less than 600 feet from my office every day for lunch. However, every time I pass there, there is always a line; and even though it moves quickly, I am usually in an extreme hurry to get lunch, as I only have 30 minutes. However, this past week, the line has been 40-60 people deep and the local news cameras have been out there filming them. I stopped by on Friday to see what the hype was all about and that's when I saw they had a "King Cake Burger" on their menu. All my Mardi Gras prayers were answered when we set up camp for the day on the parade route and ended up being next to the Food Drunk Food Truck. I have heard about their king cake burger for a while and what better day to have it other than Mardi Gras day. It was everything that good dreams are made of.... a little sweet and a little savory... reminded me of pancakes and sausage. Thankfully, I was with a crew that also wanted a taste of the king cake burger and we spilt it into 4 pieces. It is very rich and there was no way that I could finish the whole thing by myself. I hope to see Food Drunk around soon so I can try their duck fat fries. Until then... I will be dreaming about the day ...
